scripts.docker:build: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:services-rebuild: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml stop libs-builder identity-service product-service && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml rm -f libs-builder identity-service product-service && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build libs-builder identity-service product-service
scripts.docker:services-restart: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml restart libs-builder identity-service product-service
